_meta.notes: MODELED, qualitative company-commodity-country exposure overlay. Built only from free public data: each company's own disclosed operating countries intersected with USDA PSD per-commodity export rankings (wheat/corn/rice/soybeans only). Origins are RANKED, never given a fabricated percentage. No customs-attributed company volumes exist in free government data; this is the honest best-effort stand-in and is badged MODELED everywhere it renders.
